title: Source inventory density controls
summary: This iteration improves the reader-facing density of the full source inventory without hiding or reordering any source. The public inventory overview now includes static quick-location lanes for fixed sections, enablement, and source kinds, while each detail group starts with a compact density summary, type counts, a back link, and a preservation note for blocked, unconfigured, skipped, manual, or no-update entries.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory panel|source inventory navigation|source inventory density controls" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Full source visibility still needs density controls once all collection entries are expanded.
lessons.evidence: The overview adds static section, enablement, and source-kind quick-location lanes while keeping all 154 source bullets in the fixed detail groups.
lessons.recommended_action: Prefer static scan aids before adding client-side filtering that could accidentally hide canonical source rows.

lessons.lesson: Inventory group summaries should restate preservation rules where readers scan the actual entries.
lessons.evidence: Each `source-inventory-group-*` section now starts with density counts, source-kind counts, a back-to-overview anchor, and the rule that blocked, unconfigured, skipped, manual, or no-update entries stay visible.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep source gap disclosure near the source list, not only in higher-level status dashboards.

lessons.lesson: Rendered HTML needs viewport checks after adding long source-kind labels.
lessons.evidence: Desktop and mobile Playwright checks verified the inventory overview and representative source groups render without horizontal overflow after adding long kind labels such as `openrouter_rankings_public_playwright`.
lessons.recommended_action: Whenever source-kind labels or inventory tables change, include mobile overflow checks in the acceptance evidence.

lessons.lesson: Generic configuration status must not expose configuration mechanics.
lessons.evidence: A read-only review found `url` and `env_required` in public inventory output; the source status mapper and validator now use generic states such as `configured`, `configuration_needed`, `manual_review`, and `disabled`, with unit and E2E coverage rejecting the leaked tokens.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding any public inventory status, name the reader-visible state instead of the underlying config field or transport mechanism.

followups.action: If the full inventory still feels heavy after user review, add an explicitly optional search/filter interaction that never removes sources from the canonical fixed-order DOM.
